rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically going down, including moving down a route or slope.

example.english: We descend the mountain along this slope.
example.traditional: 我哋沿住呢條斜路落山。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyun4 zyu6 ni1 tiu4 ce4 lou6 lok6 saan1

rows.note: Use this when a situation itself worsens or deteriorates.

example.english: The company's business has begun to descend into a slump.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 saang1 ji3 hoi1 ci2 bin3 caa1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when intensity, strength, or a quality becomes less pronounced.

example.english: The sound began to descend in volume.
example.jyutping: go3 seng1 long6 maan6 maan6 gaam2 joek6 zo2

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone arrives suddenly and inconveniently or disruptively.

example.english: Why did you descend on my place so soon?
example.traditional: 你哋咁快就殺到我屋企喇？
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 gam3 faai3 zau6 saat3 dou3 ngo5 uk1 kei2 laa3
